name: Baarbara Estate-HSD
description: Honey sun-dried coffee is a beautifully balanced processing style where the coffee cherries are de-pulped but dried with part of the sticky, sweet mucilage still clinging to the beans. As they dry slowly under the sun, this natural sweetness infuses into the seeds, creating a cup that is smooth, syrupy, and vibrant. Expect flavours of ripe fruit, caramel-like sweetness, and a round, creamy body, all while maintaining a gentle acidity. This method highlights both the terroir and the careful craftsmanship of the producer making honey sun-dried coffees a favourite in the speciality world. name: Basan Khan Estate
description: The Basankhan Estate is a family-owned farm located in Chikmagalur, Karnataka with a rich history spanning over 100 years. It was originally founded by their great grandfather, Mr. Gulamenabi, and subsequently managed by G. Abdul Wajid & Sons. Now in its fourth generation, the estate continues to flourish.After picking cherries from the trees, the farm initiates immediate processing. Unwanted cherries are removed, and the coffee is meticulously cleaned with water. A pulping machine is then used to remove the outer layer of the cherries, after which the washed coffee is soaked in water for 12 hours before being transferred to the drying yard.The focus of the Basankhan Estate is to consistently produce the finest beans from their crop. They prioritise thorough washing by performing the process twice. The drying methods employed include mat drying, shade drying, regular drying, and more. During the drying process, careful attention is paid to rotation, ensuring equal drying by turning the coffee every hour. Flavour – Caramel, Citrus, Gooseberry Roast Level – Medium Acidity Level – Medium Bitterness Level – Low Body – Medium Altitude – 1450 MASL Processing – Washed Varietal – SLN 795 Location -Chikmagalur

name: Harley Estate (Robusta)
description: The coffee cherries for this microlot are cultivated at mid-elevation slopes of Harley Estate, located in the fertile Chikmagalur region of Karnataka. The estate utilizes traditional and sustainable farming practices, with a particular focus on selective harvesting and post-harvest innovation. Only fully ripened cherries with a Brix level above 19% are hand-harvested during peak season. This ensures optimal sugar content, contributing to flavor clarity and depth in the final cup. The outcome is a distinctively clean and complex cup, featuring structured sweetness, rich body, and layered notes of dark chocolate, citrus, and grape skin. name: Monsoon Malabar
description: Monsoon Malabar is one of India’s most legendary coffee styles born along the Malabar Coast, shaped by nature, and cherished for its unmistakable flavour. Originally discovered when wooden-hulled ships carried Indian coffee to Europe, the beans would swell, mellow, and transform during the long sea voyages through the monsoon winds. Today, this naturally occurring phenomenon is carefully recreated in controlled warehouses along the coast. Exposed to moist monsoon winds for several weeks, the beans undergo a slow, deliberate transformation: their colour turns pale gold, their size nearly doubles, and their acidity softens beautifully. The result is a bold, smooth, and earthy cup with notes of spice, wood, cocoa, and a gentle sweetness, finishing with a low-acid, rounded body that makes it perfect for espresso and milk-based drinks. At Roastery Coffee House, our Monsoon Malabar celebrates India’s heritage an ode to tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique terroir of the Western Ghats. Rich, comforting, and unmistakably Indian. name: Ratnagiri Estate-Amara Rose
description: This is a 48-hour CULTURE PROCESS natural processed coffee. It is from the SLN 9 varietal grown at 4400 feet from the block called GODOWN Patte. The Brix of the coffee cherries was 25.4 when harvested and they were put in the Bio fermenters after floater removal. Lab Culture microbes and lactic acid bacteria was added to the coffee in the fermenters and allowed to ferment for 48 hours in a carbon dioxide rich environment. After removing the coffee, they were directly put on raised beds for slow drying. The coffee was then dried slowly with constant stirring over the next 29 days. Flavour- Rose, Orange Blossom, Lychee Roast Level-Light Plus Acidity Level-Medium Bitterness Level-Low Body- Medium Altitude-1450 MASL Processing- Culture process Natural Varietal-SLN 7 Location-Chikmagalur
